introduction: A Super Mario 3 movie is happening, and one of the actors teased its release date window. The update follows The Super Mario Galaxy Movie's near-billion-dollar theatrical run. Keegan-Michael Key, who voices Toad in the animated franchise, shared the projected timeline. His remarks align with earlier comments from costar Jack Black.Super Mario Movie 3 could arrive in 2029, says actorKey shared that the Super Mario 3 movie will have a 2029 theatrical release date window. The actor framed the extended wait as a creative choice by directors Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic."We want to get everything right. We want to get all the details right," Key told ScreenRant. "And Michael and Aaron, who are our directors, have a real passion for this. I think they're as passionate about these projects as the audience is. And so we got to get it right, we got to get it right. So I apologize. But it'll be worth the wait. It'll be worth the wait…'29 is better than sometime, right?"
